review.why: Recruiter-side CLI guide: create and publish LinkedIn job postings and read applicants. Not for job seekers.
review.summary: Documents the Curviate CLI commands to draft, price, publish and close LinkedIn job postings and to read applicants and their resumes, with traps (subscription gate, stale read-back), a safe draft-then-publish flow and exit codes. It serves the hiring side, not someone building a resume.
strengths: Careful about what is proven versus never live-fired
Draft-first flow with --preview before every write
Exit codes table to branch on
cautions: Hiring-side tool: does not help a resume or career kit
Needs a global npm install and an API key; promoted publishes spend real money
Reads applicants' contact details and resumes
